test_cases.name: Primary Screen Capture Accuracy
test_cases.setup: Virtual desktop screen geometry queried via Win32 GetSystemMetrics.
test_cases.action: Captured full desktop bitmap via GDI BitBlt + CAPTUREBLT with Per-Monitor DPI Aware v2.
test_cases.expected_result: Bitmap dimensions match virtual desktop bounds (2880x1800); 0 buffer leaks.
test_cases.limitations: Measures GDI BitBlt transfer speed into Pillow 32-bit BGRA buffer.

test_cases.name: DPI Coordinate Normalization Contract
test_cases.setup: Per-Monitor DPI Aware v2 context set at process initialization.
test_cases.action: Mapped test client coordinate against live Win32 ClientToScreen ground truth.
test_cases.expected_result: Physical screen translation error is strictly <= 1.0 physical pixel.
test_cases.actual_observation: Accuracy confirmed: True, Error Distance: 0.00 px.
test_cases.limitations: Mathematical rounding contract verified against native User32 ClientToScreen.

test_cases.name: Foreground Window Detection
test_cases.action: Captured foreground window observation, PID, process name, and physical visible frame.
test_cases.expected_result: Valid HWND and extended bounds captured without drop-shadow distortion.
test_cases.limitations: Extracts visible physical frame bounds excluding DWM drop-shadows.

test_cases.name: Window Lifecycle & State Detection
test_cases.action: Extracted Z-order rank, Minimized/Maximized state, and visibility flags across desktop windows.
test_cases.expected_result: All visible top-level windows enumerated in true Z-order without crashes.

test_cases.name: Independent Accessibility Traversal
test_cases.setup: Decoupled UIAutomationProvider and MSAAProvider dispatched independently via coordinator.
test_cases.action: Traversed accessibility hierarchy for target HWND 3935208.
test_cases.expected_result: Independent ProviderResults generated; element provenance preserved.
test_cases.limitations: MSAA and UIA execute independently; failures do not cascade.

test_cases.name: Traversal Watchdog & Soft Timeout
test_cases.setup: Coordinator configured with watchdog soft timeout limit.
test_cases.action: Executed traversal under constrained timeout budget.
test_cases.expected_result: Coordinator stops waiting at soft timeout; worker state marked ABANDONED_STILL_ACTIVE; no main thread hang.
test_cases.limitations: SOFT_TIMEOUT does not force-kill native blocked COM threads; worker marked abandoned.

test_cases.name: Screen / Accessibility Alignment
test_cases.setup: Physical window client rectangle bounds mapped to virtual screen capture space.
test_cases.action: Cropped screen bitmap at client bounding rectangle.
test_cases.expected_result: Cropped image dimensions match physical client bounds exactly.
test_cases.limitations: Validates physical pixel alignment between GDI screen bitmap and window geometry.

test_cases.name: Multi-Dimensional Ground Truth Matching
test_cases.setup: Multi-source fusion engine reconciling spatial containment, Z-order, and text agreement.
test_cases.action: Fused screen capture bitmap with window metadata and accessibility nodes.
test_cases.expected_result: Produces structured DetectedTargets with explicit confidence levels.
test_cases.actual_observation: Fused Targets: 1, Overall Confidence: LOW_CONFIDENCE, Conflicts: 0.
test_cases.limitations: Decomposes confidence into Spatial Agreement, Semantic Agreement, and Freshness.

test_cases.name: Visual Change Detection (Layer V1)
test_cases.setup: Layer V1 64-bit difference hashing (dHash) and perceptual variance evaluator.
test_cases.action: Evaluated difference hash across baseline frame and modified visual frame.
test_cases.actual_observation: Change Detected: True (dHash Hamming Distance > Threshold).
test_cases.limitations: Visual change detection validates pixel deltas; does NOT infer semantic control changes.

test_cases.name: Observation Freshness & Staleness (TTL)
test_cases.setup: FreshnessTracker with high-resolution timestamp TTL boundary.
test_cases.action: Evaluated snapshot freshness at T0 and at T0 + delta_t (> TTL).
test_cases.expected_result: Snapshot valid initially; declared STALE with reason TTL_EXPIRED after age threshold.
test_cases.actual_observation: Fresh Check: True (NONE), Expired Check: False (TTL_EXPIRED).
test_cases.limitations: Enforces mathematical time-to-live boundaries on historical desktop snapshots.

test_cases.name: Rapid Focus Switching Invalidation
test_cases.setup: Snapshot tagged with generation G; focus shift increments generation to G + 1.
test_cases.action: Evaluated Snapshot Identity Validation against incremented desktop generation.
test_cases.expected_result: Snapshot declared STALE immediately; prevents reuse across focus shifts.
test_cases.actual_observation: Valid: False, Invalidation Reason: FOREGROUND_CHANGED, Generation Delta: 1.
test_cases.limitations: Monotonic generation parity prevents action execution on historical focus states.

test_cases.name: Window Destruction Invalidation
test_cases.setup: Snapshot associated with closed or destroyed window handle (0xDEADBEEF).
test_cases.action: Evaluated Snapshot Identity Validation against destroyed target handle.
test_cases.expected_result: Detected IsWindow == False; snapshot declared STALE with reason TARGET_DESTROYED.
test_cases.actual_observation: IsWindow: False, Valid: False, Reason: TARGET_DESTROYED.
test_cases.limitations: Prevents stale observation reuse when target application window terminates.

test_cases.name: Human Takeover Invalidation Contract
test_cases.setup: Prototype B takeover contract subscriber connected to FreshnessTracker.
test_cases.expected_result: Generation incremented; all historical snapshots invalidated; forced re-observation.
test_cases.actual_observation: Takeover Count: 1, Gen Delta: 1, Valid: False.
test_cases.limitations: Validates decoupled architectural contract with Prototype B human takeover engine.

test_cases.name: Multi-Monitor Architecture Support
test_cases.setup: Simulated secondary display positioned left/above primary with negative coordinates.
test_cases.action: Mapped negative accessibility bounding rectangle through CoordinateMapper.
test_cases.expected_result: Handles signed 64-bit coordinates without arithmetic underflow or clipping bugs.
test_cases.limitations: Signed coordinate arithmetic validated; multi-monitor physical testing dependent on hardware.

test_cases.name: Contradiction & Occlusion Resolution
test_cases.setup: Target window element physically covered by overlapping foreground window higher in Z-order.
test_cases.action: Executed fusion engine spatial occlusion resolution algorithm.
test_cases.expected_result: Element marked is_occluded = True; confidence downgraded to CONFLICTING; explicit conflict logged.
test_cases.actual_observation: Occluded Detected: True, Confidence: CONFLICTING, Conflicts: 1.

measured_values.conflict_notes: Element 'Hidden Button' (PushButton) has GEOMETRIC OVERLAP with 'Top Occluding Window' (HWND 1002)

test_cases.limitations: Z-order bounding box intersection prevents false visibility assumptions on covered controls.
